newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy continuous trade from July 7.
newsitem.headline: Handlowy continuous trade from July 7.

text.p: Poland's Bank Handlowy SA which started trade on the Warsaw bourse's main market on Monday after a heavily oversubscribed public offer will begin continuous trading on July 7, the bourse's deputy head said.
"On July 7 the bourse will place Bank Handlowy shares in the continuous trading system on the bourse's main market," Piotr Szeliga told a news conference.
He said Handlowy would be traded in 100-share lots.
Bank Handlowy opened on Monday at 37.9 zlotys, 8.3 percent above its issue price.

The bourse currently trades 23 stocks and NFI participation units both in continuous trade and in the main single-price auction system and on July 1 it launches continuous trade in shares of 15 National Investment Funds (NFIs).
